Sports-commentator LoRA v2 — listening evaluation

13 configurations + real-audio ceiling · n=32 per cell · judged by gemini-3-flash on the same 0/1/2 prompt used to filter the training data · 456 clips, 0 unparsed
Headline: the task is saturated, and the LoRA is not clearly needed.

The base model with no LoRA scores 1.750/2. Real human Mediathek sports commentary scores 1.775/2 — statistically the same thing. So the ceiling for this metric is ≈1.8 and the base model is already at it. There is very little headroom for an adapter to occupy.

The best configurations reach 1.969, i.e. slightly above real recordings. Two cells clear p<0.05 raw, but with 12 comparisons against base the Bonferroni threshold is p<0.0042 and none survive it. Treat the ranking below as suggestive, not established.

Validation loss did not predict this — for the third time on this stack. The training log said epoch 1 was best and epoch 8 badly overfit (r64: 4.4237 → 5.4369, a 0.905 regression). The listener disagrees: r64_e1 and r64_e8 score identically at 1.969. Whatever epoch 8 lost in validation loss, it did not lose in how the audio actually sounds. Rank on generation-side metrics, not on loss.
Why a 0–2 scale was the wrong instrument here. Every cell lands between 1.75 and 1.97, and 75–97 % of clips get the top score. The scale is compressed against its ceiling, so it cannot separate configurations even where real differences exist. A follow-up should use pairwise A/B preference against base rather than an absolute rating — that stays sensitive when everything is already "clearly sports commentary".
What is solid from this line of work is the data filter, not the LoRA. The literal WER × quality formula put 602 of 1,000 candidates at exactly score 0 (60 % had WER 0.00) and therefore selected the half with worse transcription. Replacing it with a Gemini listening filter kept 820 of 1,000 at the top rating, and a blind judge scored the corrected selection higher on 3 of 5 dimensions (commentator-likeness +0.43 p=0.024, euphoria +0.63 p=0.003, broadcast-likeness +0.53 p=0.009). That result is properly powered and stands.
